Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Metal Wall Mounted Hexagon Tealight Candle Holder Decor - 11.5"H, Gold
Colors: Gold
Materials: Metal
Add romance and glamour to your space with this wall-mounted tealight candle holder. Gold-finished metal forms a series of five conjoined hexagons, each with a glass holder. Even in the daytime, this piece adds a sleek modern touch to your room. 34.25" W x 11.5" H x 3.75" D This tealight holder is functional while adding modern glamour to your wall Metal with gold finish; glass tealight holders
